changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Review setups (ADR 0167): what a review checks, on which kind of item and for which readers. Nothing writes them yet.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.review_setup ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_setup_item_kind CHECK (item_kind ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_setup_audience CHECK (audience IN ('OPERATIONAL', 'TEAM', 'PERSONAL')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_setup_cadence CHECK (cadence IN ('DAILY', 'WEEKLY')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_setup_budget CHECK (budget_usd > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_setup_scope CHECK (jsonb_typeof(scope) = 'object'), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_setup_evidence_slots CHECK (jsonb_typeof(evidence_slots) = 'array');

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The practice key comes first: an erasure on an older server deletes practices before it deletes a personal space, whose cascade reaches review_setup, and the same order here cannot deadlock with it.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: For every writer: a setup keeps its workspace, kind and audience, and only a team setup names teams, each a standing team project of the same workspace. Update guards only validate, so they run after the row write.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A team project never moves to another workspace. A review setup names a team by a plain id, which the admission trigger checks when it is written, so a moved team would leave the name behind in the old workspace.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER project_team_keeps_workspace AFTER UPDATE OF id, workspace_id ON public.project_team FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.keep_project_team_workspace();
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER project_team_keeps_workspace ON public.project_team; DROP FUNCTION public.keep_project_team_workspace();
